note: THREE FACTS ESTABLISHED TODAY, none written down anywhere. FIRST: digest render delta and render decisions PRINT TO STDOUT, they do not write their files. regenerate-artifacts.sh redirects them (lines 531-537). Running the bare command looks like it worked and changes nothing, so a registry edit can appear drift-free when you never regenerated. SECOND: the delta report does NOT track slug-row counts — it counts NUMBERED ids against decision 0026 — so a registry change that adds only slug rows produces ZERO digest drift. That is a real clean, not a missed regeneration, but the two are indistinguishable without knowing this. Verified: added 19 slug rows, regenerated both digest artifacts, git diff over the whole drift-check list came back clean. THIRD, and this extends the documented backtick hazard: DOUBLE QUOTES IN A BOARD NOTE BREAK IT THE SAME WAY BACKTICKS DO. A NOTE containing a quoted phrase failed with: board: expected key=value, got encodability — the quoted span was re-split in the shell context and its second word was parsed as a FIELDS token. Treat a NOTE as single-quoted plain prose: no backticks, no double quotes.
